farm.text: Your own land. The house, the coop, the barn and the fields are here.

forest.text: A big wood north of the farm, with its own lake, forage in every season and the old farmstead.

secret-woods.text: A small hidden wood with a quiet pond. Few people come here.

mountain.text: The high ground above the valley, with a mountain lake and the way down to the mines.

delta.text: Where the river reaches the sea. Marsh, tide pools and the Beach all lie here.

cove.text: A sheltered cove on the lake. It opens once the Water room of the hall is finished.

quarry.text: A rocky pit where ore and stone come out of the ground, and it keeps refilling.

hearthwell.text: The village at the heart of the valley, with the shops, the inn, the library and the hall.
